title: Cryogrinding Protocol for RNA/DNA Extraction from Planktonic Filters
author: Sarah Romac
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.beqpjdvn
materials: Put the half-assembled tube in the Becher .

steps.title: Assemble cryogrinding tube
steps.instruction: Insert the magnet into the cryogrinding tube and close the tube with the opposite extremity that contains the hole.

steps.title: Insert tube into FreezerMill
steps.instruction: Place the assembled cryogrinding tube into the FreezerMill chamber, check the liquid‑nitrogen level, and close the FreezerMill.

steps.title: Set cryogrinding parameters
steps.instruction: Program the FreezerMill with the following conditions: Precool 00:02:00, Run time 00:01:00, 1 cycle, knock rate 5 knocks per second (approximate).

steps.title: Verify LN2 level with pipette
steps.instruction: Using a 10 mL pipette, confirm that the liquid‑nitrogen level corresponds to the 5 mL graduation mark (maximum level).

steps.title: Submerge sample in LN2
steps.instruction: Pour half of a 1 L Becher with liquid nitrogen, then immerse the sample tube containing the 142 mm filter into the Becher, keeping it fully frozen; always re‑check the LN2 volume.

steps.title: Close FreezerMill lid
steps.instruction: Close the FreezerMill lid delicately.

steps.title: Fill FreezerMill tank
steps.instruction: Add liquid nitrogen to the FreezerMill tank until the “up‑limit” graduation is reached; verify the volume.

steps.title: Pre‑cool FreezerMill
steps.instruction: Wait 20–30 minutes for the FreezerMill to reach the set temperature.

steps.title: Prepare filter halves (2‑tube)
steps.instruction: Take the sample tube with tweezers, open it, and extract the 142 mm filter. If the filter resists, break the tube gently with a crab tweezer while holding it with tweezers.

substeps.instruction: Cut the filter into two halves with scissors.
Place one half into a sterile Falcon‑50 tube and submerge it in liquid nitrogen.
Cut the remaining half into two pieces and place both pieces into one of the two frozen cryogrinding tubes.

steps.title: Place half‑assembled tubes in LN2
steps.instruction: Put the two half‑assembled cryogrinding tubes into the Becher containing liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Add annotated Falcon50
steps.instruction: Insert a sterile Falcon‑50 tube, correctly annotated with the sample code, into the liquid‑nitrogen‑filled Becher; this tube will collect the final powder.

steps.title: Run cryogrinding program
steps.instruction: Start the FreezerMill program that was set in step 3; the run will complete after the programmed time.

steps.title: Retrieve cryogrinding tube
steps.instruction: When the run is complete, open the FreezerMill delicately, use the FreezerMill extractor to remove the cryogrinding tube, avoid touching it with gloves, and optionally use Kimwipe papers.

steps.title: Transfer tube to LN2 bath
steps.instruction: Place the cryogrinding tube into the Becher containing liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Open tube and remove magnet
steps.instruction: Using the FreezerMill extractor, open the cryogrinding tube and remove the magnet with tweezers.

steps.title: Collect powder in Falcon50
steps.instruction: Invert the cryogrinding tube directly inside the annotated Falcon‑50 tube to transfer the powder; use a spatula to scrape out any remaining material.

steps.title: Store powder at –80 °C
steps.instruction: Seal the Falcon‑50 tube containing the powder and store it at –80 °C until RNA/DNA extraction.

steps.title: Process second filter half
steps.instruction: Replace the Falcon‑50 tube in liquid nitrogen and repeat steps 9 through 18 for the remaining half of the 142 mm filter.

steps.title: Single‑tube workflow (optional)
steps.instruction: If processing the filter as a single tube, follow these actions:

substeps.instruction: Add liquid nitrogen to a 1 L Becher (half volume) and submerge the sample tube as in step 5.
Take the sample tube with tweezers, open it, and extract the filter; break the tube if necessary.
Place the whole filter directly into a frozen cryogrinding tube.
Assemble the cryogrinding tube (insert magnet, close tube).
Insert the tube into the FreezerMill, check LN2 level, and close the instrument.
Add a sterile, annotated Falcon‑50 tube to the LN2 bath for powder collection.
Set the cryogrinding parameters (step 3) and run the program.
After completion, retrieve the tube, transfer it to LN2, open it, remove the magnet, and collect powder into the Falcon‑50 as in steps 14‑17.

steps.title: Clean and decontaminate equipment
steps.instruction: Disassemble all cryogrinding tubes and the FreezerMill extractor. Wash all parts thoroughly with a toothbrush in the following order: 1 % diluted bleach, tap water, Milli‑Q water, 70 % ethanol. Decontaminate the bench and Becher with RNase‑Away. Place all small equipment (including the toothbrush) on aluminum foil and expose to UV light for at least 20 minutes (e.g., in a PCR hood or cross‑linker).
